overall.narrative: This is a well-architected gate-check skill with the strongest script coverage in the TJCE skill suite. Four Python scripts handle all deterministic validation while the LLM is correctly limited to quality assessment and report generation. The 8-step pipeline has proper fail-fast semantics, explicit parallelism, and a clean headless/interactive duality. At 1,226 tokens for an 8-step dual-mode workflow, the prompt is lean and purposeful. Three structural issues prevent an Excellent rating: a scoring integrity flaw where a missing LLM quality assessment silently inflates the score, implicit pipeline plumbing that relies on the LLM to infer file routing, and false-positive risk from placeholder patterns in the judicial domain.

themes.name: Scoring Integrity and Degraded Mode Gaps
findings: Missing quality-findings.json gives false perfect 30/30 on quality layer — silent quality bypass (L5 H1)
Whitespace-only artifact files pass st_size > 0 completeness check (L5 H3)
Score normalization uses undocumented magic number with silent deduction capping (L4)
No degraded mode behavior specified for infrastructure failures (L5)

Orphan IDs documented as 'warning' but scored as 'medium' severity with actual score impact (L4)

Headless maturity 7/10 — LLM dependency in Steps 4/6 creates reliability fault line (L5)
No --continue/resume support unlike sibling skills tjce-verify and tjce-ship (L5)

verdict.json vs gate-check-verdict.json naming inconsistency in Step 7 (L1)

strengths.title: Excellent LLM/script boundary
strengths.detail: All deterministic checks offloaded to Python scripts. LLM handles only subjective quality assessment and prose generation — the ideal division of labor.

strengths.title: Consistent script interfaces
strengths.detail: All 4 scripts share the same CLI pattern (positional output_folder, -o, --verbose), return structured JSON with uniform severity taxonomy, and have corresponding test files.

strengths.title: Fail-fast architecture
strengths.detail: Step 1 blocks immediately on missing artifacts with specific remediation guidance naming the fixing agent, preventing wasted LLM computation.

strengths.title: Lean token budget
strengths.detail: 1,226 tokens for an 8-step dual-mode workflow with zero waste patterns detected. Tables are load-bearing, not decorative.

strengths.title: Clean headless/interactive duality
strengths.detail: Each step documents both modes inline. Headless Contract consolidates exit codes, output paths, and no-prompt policy.

strengths.title: Weighted scoring with non-negotiables
strengths.detail: 40/30/30 split prioritizing completeness is defensible. Inegociaveis section provides unambiguous pass/fail policy with 90% threshold.

strengths.title: Actionable remediation
strengths.detail: Every finding includes a fix field pointing to a specific TJCE agent or action, closing the feedback loop.

strengths.title: Explicit parallelism
strengths.detail: Steps 2-3 correctly identified as independent and marked for parallel execution without over-specifying mechanism.

strengths.title: Good config resolution pattern
strengths.detail: On Activation loads config with explicit defaults following BMad conventions without over-explaining.

strengths.title: Path standards compliance
strengths.detail: Zero findings from path standards scanner — all references use correct patterns.

experience.summary: Strong facilitative patterns for core journeys (fail-fast with remediation, dual-mode design). Gaps in progress visibility, error explanation, infrastructure resilience, and CI integration maturity.

journeys.summary: Natural trigger phrases work well. Fail-fast with agent remediation is excellent. Gaps in orientation, progress indicators, and score effort context.
friction_points: No pre-flight orientation on expected directory structure
Score display lacks effort gradient context
bright_spots: SKILL.md frontmatter triggers on natural Portuguese phrases
Clear path to resolution on failure

journeys.summary: Headless mode is exactly right. Fail-fast avoids wasted time. Missing quiet/summary mode, diff-from-last-run, partial re-run, and auto-remediation.
friction_points: No --quiet/--summary-only mode for fast pass/fail check
No partial re-run (--layer) to skip unchanged layers
bright_spots: --headless with proper exit codes for pre-push checks
Fail-fast on missing artifacts avoids full pipeline
Exit code contract integrates cleanly with && chaining

journeys.summary: Findings have fix fields with specific agents. Layer grouping helps. Severity-to-blocking mapping is hidden and orphan ID messages lack explanation.
friction_points: Orphan ID messages lack context on what 'orphan' means
Severity to blocking/scoring mapping is hidden in Python
+/-3 line context window produces unexplained false negatives
Empty section detection misses H4+ headings
bright_spots: Every finding has a fix field with specific agent invocation
Report groups by layer for targeted remediation
Inegociaveis section is explicit about non-negotiables

journeys.summary: Headless mode works for basic CI. Gaps in schema documentation, required args validation, resume support, and idempotency.
friction_points: No JSON Schema published for verdict.json
--task-type optional in headless but required by downstream skills
No --output-dir override for CI artifact directories
LLM non-determinism in Steps 4/6 undermines idempotency
bright_spots: --headless is a proper CLI contract with exit codes
JSON output to stdout or file
No interactive prompts in headless mode

gaps: LLM dependency in Steps 4/6 creates reliability fault line for CI
Two of three output artifacts are non-deterministic
No structured error output for script crashes vs findings
No timeout or fallback specified for LLM steps

autonomous.potential: High for deterministic layers (Steps 1-3, 5). Medium for LLM layers (Steps 4, 6). The skill's architecture is well-suited for autonomous execution but needs explicit degraded-mode behavior and scoring integrity fixes.
autonomous.notes: The two-tier headless model (Tier 1 deterministic-only, Tier 2 full with LLM) would maximize autonomous potential while managing LLM reliability risk.
